rules.title: Package to bear prescribed information
rules.requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear on its package, or on a label securely affixed thereto, the following declarations, namely: (a) name, address and country of origin of the manufacturer or importer, as the case may be; (b) name of the commodity; (c) net quantity; (d) unit sale price; (e) retail sale price; (f) date of manufacturing or pre-packing; (g) best before or use by date; (h) batch number; (i) dimensions; (j) length; (k) width; (l) height; (m) area; (n) volume; (o) weight; (p) numerical count; (q) quantity contained in terms of weight, measure or number; (r) name and address of the person to whom the commodity is sold; (s) consumer care contact details
rules.limitations: Cannot verify if all legally required declarations are present if OCR fails to detect text

rules.title: Name, address and country of origin
rules.requirement: The name and address of the manufacturer or the name and address of the importer, as the case may be, and the country of origin of the commodity, in case of import, shall be printed or written in a clear and legible manner.
rules.limitations: Address completeness cannot be verified from OCR alone

rules.title: Name of commodity
rules.requirement: The name of the commodity shall be printed or written on the package or on a label affixed thereto in a clear, concise, and intelligible manner.

rules.title: Mandatory declarations
rules.requirement: The following declarations shall be made on the principal display panel: (a) the name of the commodity; (b) the net quantity of the commodity; (c) the unit sale price; (d) the retail sale price; (e) the date of manufacture or pre-packing; (f) the best before or use by date, wherever applicable; (g) the batch number; (h) the name and address of the manufacturer; (i) the consumer care contact details including telephone number, email, or website.
rules.limitations: Consumer care contact may be present but not detected by OCR

rules.title: Height of numerals for MRP and net quantity
rules.requirement: The height of the numerals for the retail sale price (MRP) and net quantity shall not be less than 1mm for packages with a surface area less than 100 sq cm, 2mm for packages with surface area between 100-400 sq cm, and 3mm for packages with surface area more than 400 sq cm.
rules.limitations: Font size estimation from arbitrary photos is approximate. Cannot measure physical dimensions precisely. Returns REVIEW for uncertain measurements.

rules.title: Declarations on principal display panel
rules.requirement: The mandatory declarations shall be printed or written on the principal display panel of the package in a clear, prominent, and legible manner.
rules.limitations: Principal display panel identification requires visual analysis. Placement assessment is approximate.

rules.title: Legibility of declarations
rules.requirement: All declarations on the package shall be legible and conspicuous to a consumer at the time of purchase. The text shall have sufficient contrast against the background.
rules.limitations: Legibility is subjective. Contrast measurement is approximate from photos.

rules.title: Manufacturer/packer/importer details
rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer, as the case may be, shall be declared on the package.
rules.limitations: Address completeness cannot be fully verified

rules.title: Consumer care contact details
rules.requirement: The consumer care contact details, including at least one of: telephone number, email address, or website, shall be declared on the package.
rules.limitations: Contact details may be present but in small text not detected by OCR

rules.title: Net quantity in SI units
rules.requirement: The net quantity of the commodity shall be declared in terms of weight (kilogram or gram), measure (litre, millilitre), or number (count) as appropriate. Units shall follow the International System of Units (SI).
rules.limitations: Cannot verify actual quantity matches declared quantity

rules.title: Standard quantities for pre-packaged commodities
rules.requirement: Pre-packaged commodities shall be sold only in standard quantities as specified in the First Schedule of the rules. Non-standard quantities require specific approval.
rules.limitations: Standard quantity lists may not cover all products

rules.title: Unit sale price
rules.requirement: The unit sale price shall be declared in terms of per unit, per kilogram, per litre, or per number, as the case may be.
rules.limitations: Unit price may not be present on all packages

rules.title: Date of manufacture or pre-packing
rules.requirement: The date of manufacture or pre-packing shall be declared in the format DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY or Month Year. Best before or use by date shall also be declared where applicable.
rules.limitations: Date format recognition varies. Some dates may be in regional formats.

rules.title: Country of origin for imports
rules.requirement: In the case of imported commodities, the country of origin shall be declared on the package.
rules.limitations: Import status may not be determinable from image alone

rules.title: Actual quantity verification
rules.requirement: The actual quantity of the pre-packaged commodity shall be verified through physical examination and testing as per the prescribed procedures.
rules.limitations: This rule CANNOT be verified from images. Requires physical weighing/measurement.

rules.title: Maximum permissible errors
rules.requirement: The maximum permissible errors in the net quantity of pre-packaged commodities shall be as specified in the Second Schedule.
rules.limitations: This rule CANNOT be verified from images. Requires physical measurement and MPE calculation.

rules.title: Complaints handling procedure
rules.requirement: Every manufacturer or packer shall have a procedure for handling consumer complaints and shall display the consumer care contact on the package.
rules.limitations: Cannot verify if the complaints procedure actually exists, only if contact is present
